text:
olivia (Product PM): Quick sync — customer ACME flagged the observability deliverables. Main asks: per-tenant cost slices for invoices + span-level error attribution. We need to decide v1 scope vs stretch.

devon (Eng): For cost, we can produce coarse per-tenant views by surfacing billing tags from requests into the console. True span-level attribution (every span mapped to tenant) requires trace propagation + storage changes.

ajay (SRE): +1. Also retention/cost is the killer. If we do full-span attribution we pay huge egress/storage. Can we do sampled error-span links as MVP?

maria (Customer Success): ACME said they won't go live without invoice-ready per-tenant cost exports. They can accept sampled traces for errors if we call out sampling rate upfront.

olivia (Product PM): Proposal: MVP = 1) dashboards: per-model + per-route + per-tenant (coarse via billing tag) 2) CSV export that maps to their invoicing schema 3) sampled trace links for the top error classes (e.g., top 1% by frequency) and an indicator when a trace is sampled. Stretch = full 100% span-level error attribution, UI billing breakdown per-tenant, and deep-link to trace viewer.

devon (Eng): Rough eng estimate: MVP ~ 3 sprints with a focused team (2 backend eng, 1 infra). Key constraints: sampling config + a join key between traces and billing. Stretch adds ~2 sprints for storage schema + index work.

olivia (Product PM): Draft launch criteria (must pass to go GA):
- cost panels show per-route and per-tenant numbers within 2% of billing export
- CSV export matches finance schema and validated by CS
- trace links for top errors surface the original span ID and error message
- trace-link latency <= 500ms for 95th percentile
- privacy/compliance: redaction controls for Private deployments

ajay (SRE): Operational requirements: default sampling = 5% (configurable), auto-throttle sampling if trace-store lag > 60s, and fallback to error-only capture. Also add a rollout guard to avoid blowing up trace DB.

devon (Eng): Suggested rollout policy snippet for the release playbook:

```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  metrics:
    - name: error_link_success_rate
      threshold: 99
    - name: cost_export_accuracy_pct
      threshold: 98
  rollback_on:
    - error_link_success_rate < 98
    - trace_store_lag > 60s
```

olivia (Product PM): Owners: devon (eng lead) + ajay (infra/SRE) for implementation, maria to coordinate ACME pilot and validation, olivia owns acceptance criteria and launch comms.
